card.name: Words right before "temperatures" in climate text
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected "temperatures", such as rising, raising, sea, global or average, in climate and weather writing. It marks the spot where "temperature(s)" is likely to come next.

modes.label: Rising/raising
modes.description: A verb or adjective of increase that leads into temperatures.
modes.example: A comprehensive USDA study concludes<< rising>> temperatures could cost farmers millions as they battle

modes.label: Sea or global modifier
modes.description: A qualifier such as sea or global that comes before surface or average temperatures.
modes.example: Specifically,<< sea>> surface temperatures in the Central Pacific and North

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "temperature" or "temperatures" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "temperatures" in climate writing, when that word is about to come up.
